scope: Accounting verifier development only, preserved without changing formal originals

observed_initial_failure.cause_verified: SCRIPT.py was saved by a Windows text writer with CRLF. WORKER_EVENTS records the SHA256 of the LF code string actually sent to the worker.

correction: Read and hash the original file, normalize CRLF to LF for the worker-code equality assertion, retain both byte lengths and the original file hash. Every host script is checked against its recorded worker code SHA256.
